purpose: Block GPU tranche 1 when the campaign cannot distinguish a plausible incremental edge from session-level noise.

confidence_and_power.planning_multiplicity_method: conservative Bonferroni approximation to the frozen maxT family

census_provenance.role: design diagnostic only; never model-quality evidence

session_variance_components.reason: The remaining-session oracle-minus-P5 increment is the census ceiling aligned with the whole-path entry objective. It is a ceiling, not expected model performance.

projected_trade_counts.source: FT2-10 calibration_spec.json frozen design trade-rate band
projected_trade_counts.rare_trade_rule: Low realized trade count routes insufficient_evidence when ESS or MDE is inadequate; it is not silently rejected for missing an arbitrary cadence.

mde_formula.primary_actual_inference: The campaign uses the 20,000-resample maxT procedure, not Bonferroni. Bonferroni is the preregistered conservative spend-planning approximation.

economic_mean_session_dollars.formula: 0.25 * 5645.804347826087 census remaining-session oracle-minus-P5 mean session increment
economic_mean_session_dollars.interpretation: Campaign 1 is not assumed capable of harvesting more than one quarter of a hindsight ceiling before learned exits. This is a maximum plausible incremental edge for resource planning, not a required profit target.

whole_path_DeltaQ.interpretation: A 0.05 mean decision-local improvement is the smallest effect treated as meaningfully distinguishable for sufficiency classification. It is not an acceptance threshold; acceptance still requires an adjusted lower bound strictly above zero.

required_from_FT2_30_checkpoint_resume_d: session-cluster standard deviation of DeltaQ versus P5
session-cluster standard deviation of DeltaQ versus matched random
checkpoint/resume proof costing at most 10 dollars
pre_tranche_measurement.quality_mde_formula: For each required DeltaQ contrast, substitute the training-only pilot session standard deviation and actual ledger count into the multiplicity-planning formula.

all_required: checkpoint/resume dry-run proof costs at most 10 dollars
actual pooled DeltaQ MDE <= 0.05 for both P5 and matched-random contrasts
ordered multiplicity ledger is frozen and hashed
all MDE inputs are training-side or census-design diagnostics
first_gpu_tranche_gate.per_fold_interpretation: A 45-session fold is not required to be individually significant. Its MDE explains why the hard era rule is directional consistency rather than five separate significance tests.
first_gpu_tranche_gate.current_design_arithmetic_note: The conservative pooled census planning MDE of 1386.9974872666062 dollars is only 24.4535996899155 dollars below the 1411.4510869565217 plausible bound. This narrow margin does not authorize spend; FT2-30 must replace planning assumptions with the actual training-only pilot variances and ledger count.
